title: The critical Ising magnetization field can be reconstructed from its $+/-$ interfaces
summary: The critical Ising model admits several natural scaling limits. For an Ising model on a lattice approximation $D^a$ of a planar domain $D$, the rescaled spin field converges, as $a\to0$, to the critical Ising magnetization field (IMF), a rough random distribution on $D$, while the spin interfaces converge to a nested $CLE_3$ and the FK--Ising representation converges to a colored $CLE_{16/3}$. In this work, we prove that the IMF can be directly reconstructed from the nested $CLE_3$. This complements the previously known construction of the IMF from the colored $CLE_{16/3}$ [CGN15]. Our…
